findings.label: VPS PHP-FPM pool config note missing
findings.message: VPS_DEPLOYMENT.md covers PHP-FPM install, php.ini tweaks, socket verification, and systemctl restart php8.4-fpm, but never touches the FPM pool file (/etc/php/8.4/fpm/pool.d/www.conf) the spec called out (e.g. listen socket path, pm settings, user/group). Non-blocking — the guide deploys correctly as written. Optionally add a short pool-config note for completeness.
